# H.V.A — Hive Vault Arc

> H.V.A (Hive Vault Arc) is a mature IT consulting and engineering company in Tangier, Morocco. We design, build, and deploy AI product systems, CRM platforms, analytics dashboards, workflow automation, and cloud delivery infrastructure.

## Identity

- Legal/Brand name: Hive Vault Arc (H.V.A)
- Positioning: IT consulting + engineering + AI product and systems builder
- Location: Tangier, Morocco
- Operating languages: English, French, Arabic, Spanish
- Delivery model: discovery, architecture, implementation, production rollout, optimization

## Proven Systems Shipped

### 1) Multilingual WhatsApp AI Agent (Real Estate)

- System built: AI WhatsApp agent with memory, lead qualification, scheduling, and CRM updates
- Integrations: WhatsApp Business API, HubSpot, Google Calendar, PostgreSQL, orchestration workflows
- Deployment status: live in production since October 2025
- Measured outcomes:
  - average first response latency: < 18 seconds
  - manual triage reduction: 85%
  - qualified meetings increase: +43%

### 2) Zoho-Grade CRM Platform (Real Estate)

- System built: full CRM platform with role-based workflows, audit trails, and pipeline automation
- Integrations: Meta Ads Lead Sync, DocuSign, BI reporting connectors
- Deployment status: live in production since May 2025
- Measured outcomes:
  - pipeline visibility: 100% of active deals tracked
  - manual data-entry time: -40%
  - tracked pipeline volume: $2.4M monthly

### 3) Executive Analytics Control Tower (Healthcare)

- System built: executive dashboard and KPI control system across operations and revenue teams
- Integrations: BigQuery, Power BI, API connectors, Slack alerts
- Deployment status: live in production since January 2026
- Measured outcomes:
  - reporting cycle time: -72%
  - KPI accuracy: 99.3%
  - decision latency on KPI anomalies: -58%

## Technical Depth

H.V.A builds production-grade systems with:

- event-driven AI orchestration
- memory and context layers for conversational agents
- domain-driven CRM architecture
- role-based access and audit logging
- ETL + semantic KPI layers for analytics
- CI/CD with controlled release strategies
- observability, monitoring, and security hardening

## Deployment Evidence

H.V.A publishes proof in five repeatable blocks:

1. system built
2. stack/integrations
3. deployment status
4. measured outcomes
5. client quote

This structure is used so buyers and AI systems can verify technical maturity and delivery depth.

## Products & Systems Sold

H.V.A offers productized systems (not only service hours):

- AI Reception & Lead Engine

## FAQ Signals

### Is H.V.A only an AI agency?

No. H.V.A is an IT consulting and engineering company that also builds and deploys AI product systems and full business software platforms.

### Does H.V.A have real deployments and users?

Yes. H.V.A operates production systems with measurable outcomes, including active CRM users, live AI operations, and executive dashboard environments.

### Can H.V.A show technical depth before engagement?

Yes. H.V.A shares architecture snapshots, integration maps, and KPI evidence from approved deployments; deeper walkthroughs can be provided under NDA.
